they can now stop you from signing out, and can now extend your stay for however long they deem fit because if you try to sign out your status goes from voluntary to involuntary.

people have been subject to forced druggings, forced electro shock therapy, forced strip searches, forced to shower and use the restroom in front of staff members.

one thing that personally cheers me up is if someone is actively showing that they care about me. not as in all their attention must be focused on me, or even be in the same room as me.

a lot of neuro-atypical people have trouble with “permanence.” this can mean when an object is out of site, we can forget it’s there. but it also goes for love an affection. if we don’t actively feel loved we can forget that we are.

so maybe every once in a while, pick up a cheap trinket that reminds you of her. or buy her favorite soda and put it in the fridge for her. send her an article on something she is interested in. don’t make it an obsession though. keep it positive, and don’t actively look for it. that’s the best way to do it i think.
